test_06_linked_views.method: Manual browser test (Claude browser pane, Next dev + FastAPI). Real held-out case BraTS-GLI-00402-000 with synthetic marker: rod along k through voxel (170,150) + 3x3x3 cube at (170,150,100), processed by the real /api/predict. Click positions located with NiiVue frac2canvasPosWithTile, then real mouse clicks; readout read from the DOM.
test_06_linked_views.views_linked: axial, coronal, sagittal and 3D crosshair all moved to the marker (screenshot check)
test_06_linked_views.orientation: marker displayed on the L side, posterior, superior; matches affine-derived expectation L/P/S
test_06_linked_views.observation: The model labelled the synthetic bright marker cube as enhancing tumour (seg=4) - expected behaviour for an artificial T1Gd hyperintensity; the marker case is a viewer test only.
